status: mixed: see statusVocabulary and each collection; only items marked owner-approved-reusable-wording are Owner-approved, and they remain subject to their clientFactConfirmationRequired and culturalReviewRequired flags

statusVocabulary.owner-approved-reusable-wording: Owner-approved wording alternative that may be reused across invitations. Approval covers the wording choice only; it is not a statement about any client's facts or a substitute for cultural review, and every selection stays editable per invitation.
statusVocabulary.client-editable-personal-information: Per-invitation client data (names, relationships, dates, times, venues, surnames). Never a catalogue constant; the fictional sample values are demonstration data only.
statusVocabulary.client-fact-confirmation-required: Wording, approved or not, that asserts a fact about the event or family (music, turmeric application, marigolds, yellow attire, blessings, parent/child relationships, living or deceased status). Use only after the client confirms the fact.
statusVocabulary.cultural-review-required: Sacred, Sanskrit, Hindi or Hindi/Urdu wording. Owner approval of the wording choice does not replace review by a culturally and linguistically fluent person and, where relevant, the family or officiant.
statusVocabulary.pending-owner-review: Recorded but not yet approved by the Owner; do not offer as approved wording.
statusVocabulary.rejected: Rejected by the Owner. Kept only as decision history; never selectable.
statusVocabulary.legacy-editorial-candidate: Earlier editorial draft that was never Owner-approved. Superseded wherever an approved collection covers the same slot.

One shared horizon now stretches before them.
What once were separate dreams now have room to grow together.
The sweetest journeys begin with someone beside you.

Two stories meet, and a new one begins.
The future feels brighter when they face it together.
They found each other, and chose to make a life together.
Love grows in every little choice to stay close.
They chose each other; now, they invite you to celebrate that choice.
Their love is made of ordinary days and extraordinary devotion.
In each other, they found a partner for every season.
Love brought them close; commitment carries them forward.
Each new day is another chance to choose each other.
A lasting love begins with two people saying yes to tomorrow.
Together, they have found the courage to dream bigger.
Their promise is simple: to keep walking through life together.
In each other, they found a place to belong.
Every shared smile brought them a little closer to today.
Their favourite place has become wherever they are together.
In the little moments, a great love took shape.
They learned that home can be a person.
A thousand small moments led to this one beautiful beginning.
Their love feels like coming home.

The best kind of adventure is the one they take together.
Here's to the love that brought them here.
They fell in love. Then they kept choosing more life together.
From their first hello to this new beginning, what a journey.
Two favourite people, one unforgettable beginning.
They are ready for the next adventure, side by side.
A love this joyful deserves to be celebrated.
Their next chapter starts here, with hearts full of hope.
They make a wonderful team, and their story is just beginning.
Their love has brought two circles of loved ones together.
Their joy becomes a celebration shared with everyone they love.
Their story has room for all the people who helped shape it.
Love has brought them together, and joy has gathered us here.
A new chapter begins, surrounded by the people who matter most.
What began between two hearts now fills two families with joy.
Their love is theirs; this celebration is one we share.
Together with their loved ones, they welcome a beautiful beginning.
The happiest beginnings are the ones we share with family and friends.
Two people found love, and many hearts came together to celebrate it.
With love in their hearts, they step into a life together.
Their journey together begins with a promise made in love.
A bond built with care becomes a promise for the years ahead.
They come together with hope for all their tomorrows.
In love and friendship, they begin this new chapter.
Their hearts are ready for a lifetime of shared days.
A cherished love now becomes a shared future.
Their celebration honours the love that has grown between them.
Their promise marks the beginning of a life lived side by side.
Love has brought them here, and hope will carry them onward.
A beautiful kind of forever begins with this moment.
The days ahead shine a little brighter when imagined together.
Among all life's possibilities, they found a future in each other.
Their dreams have found a place to grow side by side.
For a moment, the world slows down to celebrate their love.
What they found in each other feels like the start of everything.
Love has made the ordinary world feel wonderfully new.
The best part of tomorrow is knowing they will meet it together.
Their hearts have written the first line of a new story.
Here, surrounded by beauty, their next chapter begins.
